input.title: importText: Cursor incorrectly moves to SimplePath when importing into context view context
input.body:
- [ ] Blocked by #1633 

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - m
- b
  - m
```

1. Activate the context view on `b/m`.
2. Set the cursor on `b/m~/a`.
3. Activate New Subthought.
4. Paste `x`.

## Current Behavior

`x` is pasted correctly but cursor moves to `a/m/x`.

https://github.com/cybersemics/em/assets/750276/e6aa07d7-8f76-4bd9-9cf0-811e1bd8c5b9

## Expected Behavior

Cursor should stay on `b/m~/a/x`.

## Testing

Add a reducer test.
